About this home

Fabulous opportunity to live on a quiet, tucked-away cul-de-sac in The Colonies, one of the West End’s most desirable neighborhoods. Meticulously maintained and cared for, this home offers hardwood floors throughout the main level (ceramic in the kitchen) and a well-appointed kitchen with a gas cooktop, double oven, white cabinetry and granite countertops—ideal for family cooking and entertaining. Formal living and dining rooms complement more casual gathering spaces including a family room and a bright Florida room that opens to custom Trex (Transcend) decking and a spacious, park-like . 85-acre backyard. Upstairs, the primary suite features neutral wall-to-wall carpet, a large ensuite with jetted tub, separate shower, two vanities and a walk-in closet. Four additional bedrooms (one with its own ensuite) plus a hall bath, a walk-up attic accessed from the second bedroom, and a 16 x 14 loft above the garage provide abundant storage and flexible space. The community amenities—tennis courts, pool, clubhouse and playground—round out a comfortable, move-in ready home. Lots of sledding opportunities in this area for kids and adults alike! Recent updates include new windows, Hardie plank siding, Trex deck, and Rinnai water heater. About 35 years remaining life of Timberline Roofing. Full yard irrrigation.

Summary of 12514 Cottage Cove Ct
  • Quiet cul-de-sac in The Colonies with tennis courts, pool, clubhouse, playground.
  • Main level hardwood floors; kitchen with gas cooktop, double oven, granite counters.
  • Florida room opens to Trex Transcend decking and a spacious backyard.
  • Primary suite features jetted tub, separate shower, dual vanities, walk-in closet.
  • Four bedrooms, one with ensuite; hall bath; loft and walk-up attic.
  • Two-car garage with 2 spaces and brick exterior.
